steps.message:
# Several things look wrong in a race recording

I recorded a short race (`recording.mp4`) and several things in it don't look the way they
normally do in this game.

Some of what a vehicle carries, or has carried, is drawn or hidden wrongly compared with that
vehicle (it can show through something that covers the vehicle, instead of being hidden with
it, and its effects can be off too), some shadows
don't fall or turn like the others in the clip, and the race view sometimes shows more of the
road behind the vehicle it follows than ahead of it. Which things, when, and what they should
look like instead can be seen in the recording: the same kind of thing is drawn correctly
elsewhere in the same clip.

Please fix all problems. Apart from these, the track layout and the vehicles' movement in
the recording are correct and should keep looking the way they do now.

## Attached visual evidence

The recording is at `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4`.

Inspect the attached video before making changes. You can pull individual frames out of it with
`ffmpeg`.

arguments.command: cd /app; git ls-files | head -100; git ls-files | wc -l; ls .harbor_assets; ffprobe .harbor_assets/recording.mp4 2>&1 | tail -5

steps.message:
I fixed all three problems from the recording. The code compiles and the existing `core-tests` pass. I haven't run the game to make a new recording, so I haven't seen the result on screen yet.

**Carried items (the bridge scene, ~8.5–10 s)**
- **Missile drawn through the bridge** (`bonus/Missile.java`): a missile waiting on a car was always drawn in the topmost layer. That's why it stayed visible under the bridge while the car was hidden. A carried missile is now drawn in the same layer as its car, so the bridge hides both. It also takes the car's colour tint, so it darkens with the car when the car sinks into water. Once fired, it is drawn in the topmost layer as before.
- **Missile exhaust flame to one side** (same file): the flame was offset across the missile instead of along it, so it appeared beside the missile. It now comes out of the tail, the same way the turbo flame sits behind a car.
- **Mine** (`bonus/Mine.java`): a mine still attached to a car was always drawn at ground-vehicle level, even when the car was in the air. It now follows the car's layer. I didn't see this one in the clip; I changed it because it had the same flaw as the missile.

**Shadows**
- **Shadows not turning** (`utils/BodyRegionDrawer.java`): shadows for the missile, mines, bonus spots and obstacles were given an angle in radians where degrees were expected. So they didn't rotate with their object, which was visible on the fired missile. They now turn with what casts them.
- **Car shadow falling the wrong way** (`racer/VehicleRenderer.java`): the car's shadow fell up and to the left, while every other shadow in the game falls down and to the right. It now falls down and to the right like the rest.

**Camera** (`racescreen/RacerCameraUpdater.java`)
- **Showing more road behind the car**: the camera's look-ahead used a mirrored angle, so on some headings it moved behind the car instead of in front. It now always moves ahead in the direction the car is travelling.
- **Speed limit on camera movement**: the code computed this limit but applied it only after the camera had already moved, so it had no effect. It now takes effect. In normal driving the limit is well above how fast the camera moves, so it should only smooth out sudden jumps, but it is the one change that could alter the view slightly. I also removed a duplicate zoom-limit call, which changed nothing.

I didn't touch the track layout or how the vehicles move.
